Author: Vipin Chandra Dixit
Bench: Vipin Chandra Dixit
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 92
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 59650 of 2022
Applicant :- Jamshed @ Shamshad

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Jagdish Prasad Mishra
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Manoj Kumar Rai Hon'ble Vipin Chandra Dixit,J.
Heard Sri Jagdish Prasad Mishra, learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA for the State, Sri Manoj Kumar Rai, learned counsel for the informant and perused the material on record.
Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this case.
The applicant is not named in the F.I.R.
The applicant is brother-in-law (Jeth) of the deceased.
As per averments of F.I.R. the deceased was living at Bijnor with her husband.
The applicant has no concern with the family affairs of the deceased and her husband and the applicant is living at Muzaffarnagar.
The statement of informant was recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C. and there was no allegation against the applicant.
The name of applicant was surfaced in the majid statement of informant which was recorded after about 2 months of the alleged incident.
There is no possibility of applicant of fleeing away from the judicial process or tampering with the prosecution evidence.
He next submits that the applicant has no criminal history and is in jail since 16.11.2022 and if released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail.

sentences.text: Learned AGA for the State as well as learned counsel for the informant vehemently opposed the prayer of bail.

Upon hearing the learned counsel for the parties and upon the perusal of the record and considering the complicity of accused, severity of punishment as well as totality of facts and circumstances, at this stage, without commenting on the merits of the case, I find it a fit case for bail.
The bail application is allowed.

Let applicant- Jamshed alias Shamshad be released on bail in Case Crime No. 411 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 304B IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, registered at P.S. Kotwali City, District Bijnor,
on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of Court concerned, subject to the following conditions:
(i) The applicant will not tamper with prosecution evidence in any manner whatsoever.
(ii) The applicant will abide by the orders of the court, will attend the court on every date and will not delay the disposal of trial in any manner whatsoever.
(iii) The applicant will not indulge in any unlawful activity.
(iv) The applicant will not misuse the liberty of bail in any manner whatsoever.

The identity, status and residential proof of sureties will be verified by the court concerned and in case of breach of any of the conditions mentioned above, court concerned will be at liberty to cancel the bail and send the applicant to prison.

Order Date :- 21.2.2023 Kpy  Jamshed @ Shamshad vs State Of U.P. on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/83315523/
